summary: Skip a sanity test only when it crashes with a traceback on correct content, file a bug, and review skips periodically since fixes aren't detected automatically.
questions: When should I skip a sanity test instead of ignoring it?

answer_card.title: When to skip sanity tests
answer_card.answer_md: Tracebacks can't be ignored. If the content is wrong, fix it; if it's correct, file a bug and **skip** the test until fixed. Skips hide regressions and resolution isn't detected, so review them periodically.
